from: October book, night 22 (Known Before You Were Born)
p1: Long ago, Jeremiah grew up in a family of priests who served the Lord.
One day the Lord spoke to Jeremiah. The Lord was Jesus, speaking for Heavenly Father.
He said, “Before I made you in your mother’s tummy, I knew you. Before you were born, I chose you to be a prophet.” Jeremiah would tell people Heavenly Father’s words.
p2: How could the Lord know Jeremiah before he was born? Latter-day prophets teach that we lived with Heavenly Father before coming to earth. We lived there as spirits, the real us inside.
Heavenly Father knew you there, and He knows you now. He has loved you from the very start.
old: Long, long ago, Heavenly Father's people had stopped listening to Him. They had forgotten His kind rules, and they were going the wrong way. So Heavenly Father picked a young man named Jeremiah to help. A prophet is someone Heavenly Father asks to tell the people what He says. Jeremiah was going to be a prophet.

Heavenly Father said to Jeremiah, "Before I made you, I knew you." That means Heavenly Father knew Jeremiah long before Jeremiah was a baby. He knew him first. He loved him first. He already had a good job ready for him.
Jeremiah looked down at his own small hands. "But I am only a child," he said. "I do not know how to speak." He meant, "I am too young. I will not know what words to say."
Heavenly Father did not say, "Yes, you are too little." He said, "Do not say you are a child. Go where I send you. Say what I tell you. Do not be afraid, because I am with you." And Jeremiah went.

Heavenly Father knew you before you were born, too. He knew your laugh and your sleepy eyes. Today Beau held the door open for all his friends. Beau is little, and holding a door is a small thing, and it was a big kind thing too. You are little tonight, and you are already His, and He has small kind jobs ready for you tomorrow.
